name: Soitec SA
summary: Soitec SA develops and manufactures semiconductor materials in Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company offers CONNECT Radio Frequency Silicon-on-Insulator for smartphone front-end modules; CONNECT FD SOI for AI applications; CONNECT Piezoelectric-on-Insulator RF filters for smartphones; photonics and optical sensing solution for the integration of silicon optical components in data centers; and CONNECT RF gallium nitride which increases the frequency system efficiency and power density of next generation sub 6GHz and mmWave-band cellular 5G infrastructures and mobile devices.
